I4.quote: Searched the main text, all tables and figure captions, the Characterization section and the supplementary file (Fig. S-1, S-2, Table S1) for a specific surface area (BET, Langmuir, N2/Ar/CO2 physisorption, m2/g, pore volume, supplier value) of any sample the paper measures; none found. Characterization lists only TEM, Raman, TGA, XPS and Sieverts H2 uptake. The only 'surface area' phrase (Table 1, p. 3: 'storage capacity due to high surface area') describes a literature Pt/MOF material, not a sample of this paper.

I5.quote: Boron-doped carbon nanotubes (BCNTs) with varying B content (0–8 at%) were prepared by thermo-catalytic decomposition of ethanol in presence of boric acid at 1073 K.
I5.location: main, p. 1 (journal p. 39297), Abstract, first sentence

notes: Original Sieverts H2 uptake on pristine MWCNTs and five B-doped MWCNTs (BCNTs-I to V) at 303 K and 16 bar (0.048 to 0.497 wt%), so I1 to I3 are met; I4 fails because no sample has a reported surface area, hence no_surface_area. Not retracted (record is_retracted false; no retraction notice in the PDF). Not duplicate_data: the paper cites the authors' earlier B-doped CNT work [25] but does not state that its H2 values were published before. Internal inconsistency in conditions: the abstract says 0.497 wt% 'at 273 K and 16 bar', the Methods, Fig. 10, Tables 8-9 say 303 K and 16 bar, and one sentence on p. 11 says '303 K and 20 bar'. A T and P are stated either way, so I3 is not affected.
